fix(codeon): bind MCP issue routing to available runtimes

MCP issue create/replace now require every present binding to be in the
daemon available_runtime_profiles set, matching HTTP. Daemon MCP starts
fail-closed until bootstrap writes the preflighted System|Named identities.
Named("default") stays distinct from System.
